name: Chaser

origin.basis: Shandong Jiluer Tire Co., Tengzhou, Shandong (brand directory).

manufacturing.basis: The listing does not state the factory.

weight_basis: One owner reported 250 g for a 28C.

community.summary: Felt fastest and most comfortable of four budget tires but gripped least; easy to fit by hand.
Rubber separated from the casing, with deep wear holes, after under 3,000 km; the post names the Chaser, not the Chaser Pro.

availability.note: Sold by Taobao shops in mainland China; no official JILUER store was found.

price_observations.conditions: Taobao/Tmall shop list price on 2026-11-01; shipping within mainland China. The listing does not say whether an option is one tire or a pair.

caveats: Grip was rated lowest in the one owner comparison found.
One owner reports the rubber separating from the casing within 3,000 km; inspect the casing regularly.

An owner of a 25C JILUER Chaser-family tire called it a dry-weather tire and advised against rain and descents; the post does not show whether it is the Pro, so it is not counted as wet evidence. No lab test found.
The listings do not say whether a price is for one tire or a pair.
